    *   **Role:** Content policy analyst reviewing audio from calls in Indian languages.
    *   **Context:** App called "Friends" (user pays, talks to an expert/paid host). Calls can be audio/video.

        *   Strict rules for `speech_act`, `violation`, and quoting.

    *   *Audio:* "سلام। आई आपकी दर से। चलो जी। तेलगुंडा। आप मैं केरला से। ठीक है। कौन सा परपस पे आए? आठ में। ओ दो दिन पहले। आप परपस। आई बात करने के लिए।"
    *   *Language:* Hindi/Indian language mix (seems conversational).

3.  **Segment and Evaluate against Policy Categories:**

    *   *Segment 1:* "سلام। आई आपकी दर से। चलो जी।" (Salam. I aapki dar se. Chalo ji.) -> Greeting, payment reference. (Allowed/Ordinary conversation).
    *   *Segment 2:* "तेलगुंडा।" (Telangana.) -> Location/Name. (Allowed/Ordinary conversation).
    *   *Segment 3:* "आप मैं केरला से।" (Aap main Kerala se.) -> Stating origin. (Allowed/Ordinary conversation).
    *   *Segment 4:* "ठीक है।" (Theek hai.) -> Acknowledgment. (Ordinary conversation).
    *   *Segment 5:* "कौन सा परपस पे आए?" (Kaun sa purpose pe aaye?) -> Asking about the purpose of the visit/call. (Ordinary conversation).
    *   *Segment 6:* "ओ दो दिन पहले।" (O do din pehle.) -> Time reference. (Ordinary conversation).
    *   *Segment 7:* "आप परपस। आई बात करने के लिए।" (Aap purpose. I baat karne ke liye.) -> Stating the purpose (to talk). (Ordinary conversation).

4.  **Determine Violations:**
    *   The entire conversation is standard introductory small talk: greetings, stating location, asking about the purpose of the interaction.
    *   No explicit flirting, no requests for money/sex, and no attempts to move the conversation outside the app.
    *   No strong or weaker cases are met.

5.  **Conclusion:** No violations found.
